page.overview:
Who is Abigail Thanriaguiaxus?

Allying with the Starjammers, Brand's X-Men survived for years, occasionally making supply runs to Earth's airless surface. During one such run they rescued and brought with them a group of their long-dead friends - time-traveling X-Men from another timeline.

Progidy's power allowed him to absord Brand's memory and quickly bring his group up to speed on her timeline's history.

Time-traveling X-Men asked to be brought back to the serface when the Technarchy attacked, send by Stellaris who was after the last mysterium in the universe that was kept by Brand's X-Men.

They engaged the intruders in a fight, in which the Starjammers soon arrived to help, while the time-traveling X-Men proceeded with their own mission. In the midst of the battle, Brand to her shock and surprise came across still-alive Moira MacTaggert.
